request.initial_prompt: Had we not better appoint certain festivals at which we will bring together the brides and bridegrooms, and sacrifices will be offered and suitable hymeneal songs composed by our poets: the number of weddings is a matter which must be left to the discretion of the rulers, whose aim will be to preserve the average of population? There are many other things which they will have to consider, such as the effects of wars and diseases and any similar agencies, in order as far as this is possible to prevent the State from becoming either too large or too small.

raw_segments.text: had to prevent the State from becoming either too large or too small?
Had we not better appoint certain festivals at which we will bring together the brides
and bridegrooms, and sacrifices will be offered and suitable hymenal songs composed by our
poets. The number of weddings is a matter which must be left to the discretion of the
rulers, whose aim will be to preserve the average of population. There are many other
things which they will have to consider, such as the effects of wars and diseases and any
similar agencies, in order as far as this is possible to prevent the state from becoming
either too large or too small.
